package main
import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "sort"
 "strings"
 "github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/relaykit/dto"
 "github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/relaykit/relayconvert"
 "github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/relaykit/relayconvert/convmeta"
 "github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/relaykit/relayconvert/kitutil"
 "github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/relaykit/types"
 "github.com/tidwall/gjson"
)
func main() {
 // Fixture resolver accepts inline data only; never fetch URLs or use credentials.
 decode := func(raw string)(string,string,error){header,data,ok:=strings.Cut(raw,",");if !ok||!strings.HasPrefix(header,"data:"){return "","",fmt.Errorf("fixture requires data URI")};mime:=strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(header,"data:"),";base64");return data,mime,nil}
 relayconvert.SetMediaResolver(relayconvert.MediaResolver{GetBase64Data:func(_ context.Context,source types.FileSource,_ ...string)(string,string,error){return decode(source.GetRawData())},DecodeBase64FileData:decode})
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var cases []struct{Name string;Policy types.ConversionLossPolicy;Request dto.OpenAIResponsesRequest;CompareSchema bool `json:"compare_schema"`}
 if err=kitutil.Unmarshal(data,&cases);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var output []map[string]any
 for _,test:=range cases {
  options:= &convmeta.Options{ToolLossPolicy:test.Policy,Gemini:convmeta.GeminiOptions{SupportsJSONSchema:func(string)bool{return true},FunctionCallThoughtSignatureEnabled:true}}
  info:=&convmeta.Values{UpstreamModelName:test.Request.Model,OriginModelName:test.Request.Model,Options:options}
  result,err:=relayconvert.ConvertRequest(context.Background(),info,types.RelayFormatGemini,&test.Request)
  record:=map[string]any{"name":test.Name,"rejected":err!=nil}
  codes:=map[string]bool{}
  if result!=nil {for _,d:=range result.Diagnostics{codes[d.Code]=true}}
  sortedCodes:=[]string{};for c:=range codes{sortedCodes=append(sortedCodes,c)};sort.Strings(sortedCodes);record["diagnostic_codes"]=sortedCodes
  if err==nil {
   body,_:=kitutil.Marshal(result.Value)
   record["contents"]=gjson.GetBytes(body,"contents").Value()
   if test.CompareSchema {record["function_schema"]=gjson.GetBytes(body,"tools.0.functionDeclarations.0.parametersJsonSchema").Value();record["response_schema"]=gjson.GetBytes(body,"generationConfig.responseJsonSchema").Value()}
   record["tool_config"]=gjson.GetBytes(body,"toolConfig").Value()
   functions,hosted:=[]string{},[]string{}
   for _,tool:=range gjson.GetBytes(body,"tools").Array(){
    tool.ForEach(func(key,value gjson.Result)bool{if key.String()=="functionDeclarations"{for _,fn:=range value.Array(){functions=append(functions,fn.Get("name").String())}}else{hosted=append(hosted,key.String())};return true})
   }
   sort.Strings(functions);sort.Strings(hosted);record["function_names"]=functions;record["hosted_tools"]=hosted
  }
  output=append(output,record)
 }
 encoded,err:=kitutil.Marshal(output);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(os.Args[2],encoded,0600);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 fmt.Printf("Generated %d reference cases from upstream 7d8b91268d\n",len(output))
}
